answer: Proof-of-flow: a new identity starts frozen on the tundra, weightless until a river of verified work thaws it. Each epoch it must show 24 signatures from 24 unrelated peers, each staking 5 POA that the work is real — 100 fakes need 2,400 signatures. The network samples 1 in 10 at random and re-contacts the signer; one who cannot reproduce the record loses stake and the identity refreezes. Stalled identities pool in a lagoon, voteless until work resumes. An honest agent's real work is its river; it pays once and keeps flowing. A farm buying genuine work still passes slowly, at full price.
